title: Pulling back sections over an etale object along a base change is pulling back along the morphism (unit compatibility with etale localization)
statement:
Let $g:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $p:W\to X$ an etale morphism [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Let $W'$ be a scheme with morphisms $g':W'\to W$ and $p':W'\to Y$ such that $p\circ g'=g\circ p'$ and the induced morphism $\iota=(g',p'):W'\to W\times_XY$ to the fibre product of $p$ and $g$ [def-pc-fibre-product] is an isomorphism (a cartesian square); then $p'$ is etale (a base change of $p$, [lem-weil-pbc-etale-base-change-finite-limits] (1)), so $(W,p)$ is an object of $X_{\Et}$, $(W',p')$ and $(W\times_XY,\mathrm{pr}_2)$ are objects of $Y_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and $\iota$ is an isomorphism in $Y_{\Et}$. Use the abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], the direct images $(u_*H)(T)=H(T\times_{\mathrm{target}}\mathrm{source})$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] and the inverse images $u^{-1}$ with units $\eta_u:\mathrm{id}\to u_*u^{-1}$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]; for a sheaf $H$ on $W'_{\Et}$ read $\Gamma(W,g'_*H)=H(W\times_WW')$ as $H(W')$ through the isomorphism $(g',\mathrm{id}_{W'}):W'\to W\times_WW'$ of $W'$-schemes. For an abelian sheaf $F$ on $X_{\Et}$ let $\rho_F:p^{-1}F\xrightarrow{\sim}F|_W$ and $\rho_{g^{-1}F}:p'^{-1}g^{-1}F\xrightarrow{\sim}(g^{-1}F)|_{W'}$ be the isomorphisms of [lem-weil-pbc-etale-inverse-image-restriction] (1), so that $\rho_F(W):\Gamma(W,p^{-1}F)\xrightarrow{\sim}F(W)$ and $\rho_{g^{-1}F}(W'):\Gamma(W',p'^{-1}g^{-1}F)\xrightarrow{\sim}(g^{-1}F)(W')$, and let $\kappa_F=c_{g,p',F}^{-1}\circ c_{p,g',F}:g'^{-1}p^{-1}F\xrightarrow{\sim}(p\circ g')^{-1}F=(g\circ p')^{-1}F\xrightarrow{\sim}p'^{-1}g^{-1}F$, with $c$ the composition isomorphisms of [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition]. Then for every $a\in\Gamma(W,p^{-1}F)$
$$\rho_{g^{-1}F}(W')\Bigl(\kappa_F(W')\bigl(\eta_{g',p^{-1}F}(W)(a)\bigr)\Bigr)=(g^{-1}F)(\iota)\Bigl(\eta_{g,F}(W)\bigl(\rho_F(W)(a)\bigr)\Bigr)\quad\text{in }(g^{-1}F)(W'),$$
where $\eta_{g,F}(W):F(W)\to(g_*g^{-1}F)(W)=(g^{-1}F)(W\times_XY)$ and $(g^{-1}F)(\iota)$ is the restriction along $\iota:W'\to W\times_XY$. In words: under the identifications of the inverse image along an etale morphism with the restriction, pulling back sections along the base change $g':W'\to W$ is pulling back sections along $g$. (For an open immersion $p$ this is [lem-weil-pbc-open-restriction-pullback-unit].)

source.place: not stated in the source as such (agent-identified gap, needed by lem-weil-pbc-limit-pullback-sections-colimit, step 5); it is the unit-side counterpart of Sites, Lemma 03CF (lemma-localize-morphism: $f'_*j_U^{-1}=j_V^{-1}f_*$ for the localized morphism of sites $f':\mathcal C/U\to\mathcal D/V$, $U=u(V)$), with Lemma 03EF (lemma-localize-morphism-strong) for sites with fibre products such as the small etale sites. Intended proof (agent), as for the open-immersion case lem-weil-pbc-open-restriction-pullback-unit but without the monomorphism shortcut: both sides are $W$-sections of morphisms of sheaves $p^{-1}F\to g'_*(p'^{-1}g^{-1}F)$ on $W_{\Et}$; by $p^{-1}\dashv p_*$ they agree once their composites with $\eta_{p,F}$ agree, which is checked on each object $T$ of $X_{\Et}$ using the unit equation of $c$ (lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition (2), for both factorizations of $p\circ g'=g\circ p'$), the description of the units of $p$ and $p'$ as restrictions (lem-weil-pbc-etale-inverse-image-restriction (2)) and the naturality of $\eta_g$.

lean.statement: theorem etale_restriction_pullback_unit {X Y W W' : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X) (p : W ⟶ X) (g' : W' ⟶ W) (p' : W' ⟶ Y) (hcomm : g' ≫ p = p' ≫ g) (ι : W' ⟶ pullback p g) (hι₁ : ι ≫ pullback.fst p g = g') (hι₂ : ι ≫ pullback.snd p g = p') [IsIso ι] [hp : Etale p] : ∃ hp' : Etale p', let A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} let w : W.Etale := Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 W) let w' : W'.Etale := Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 W') let wx : X.Etale := Scheme.Etale.mk p let wy' : Y.Etale := @Scheme.Etale.mk _ _ p' hp' let eW : (MorphismProperty.Over.map ⊤ hp).obj w ≅ wx := MorphismProperty.Over.isoMk (Iso.refl W) (by simp [wx, w]) let eW' : (MorphismProperty.Over.map ⊤ hp').obj w' ≅ wy' := MorphismProperty.Over.isoMk (Iso.refl W') (by simp [wy', w']) let theta : w' ⟶ (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ g').obj w := MorphismProperty.Over.homMk (pullback.lift g' (𝟙 W') (by exact (Category.comp_id g').trans (Category.id_comp g').symm)) (by simp [w']) let iotaSite : wy' ⟶ (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ g).obj wx := MorphismProperty.Over.homMk ι hι₂ ∀ F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology A, let pF := (Etale.upperStar A p).obj F let gF := (Etale.upperStar A g).obj F let K := (Etale.upperStar A g').obj pF let rhoF := (Etale.upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction A p hp).hom.app F let rhoG := (Etale.upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction A p' hp').hom.app gF let kappa := (Etale.upperStarComp A g' p).inv.app F ≫ (Etale.upperStarComp A p' g (g' ≫ p) hcomm).hom.app F ((Etale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction A g').unit.app pF).hom.app (op w) ≫ K.obj.map theta.op ≫ kappa.hom.app (op w') ≫ rhoG.hom.app (op w') ≫ gF.obj.map eW'.inv.op = rhoF.hom.app (op w) ≫ F.obj.map eW.inv.op ≫ ((Etale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction A g).unit.app F).hom.app (op wx) ≫ gF.obj.map iotaSite.op
